name: Check Issues Against JQL
description: Checks whether one or more issues would be returned by one or more JQL queries. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-search/#api-rest-api-3-jql-match-post)

configurable_props.name: issueIds
configurable_props.label: Issue IDs
configurable_props.description: A list of issue IDs to check against the JQL queries. Example: `["10001", "10042"]`

configurable_props.name: jqls
configurable_props.label: JQL Queries
configurable_props.description: A list of JQL query strings to check the issues against. Example: `["project = FOO", "issuetype = Bug"]`
